description: This file defines the interface and implementation of a wrapper around GStreamer (Gst) functions, providing an abstraction layer for Gst operations. It includes class definitions for GstWrapper and GstWrapperFactory, with methods that wrap various Gst functions for initialization, plugin management, element creation, and other Gst operations. The file also manages external references to Gst components and defines methods for manipulating Gst structures, buffers, and elements.

classes.name: GstWrapper
classes.description: A class providing a wrapper around GStreamer functions, enabling easier and more abstracted Gst operations within the application.

classes.name: GstWrapperFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and managing singleton instances of GstWrapper and related objects.
